description: This file contains the implementation of a 3D average pooling function for quantized tensors in PyTorch's ATen backend. It defines kernel parameter extraction, output shape calculation, and the core function q_avg_pool3d that performs the pooling operation, dispatching to optimized stubs for hardware acceleration.
